documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management highlighted that FY26 was a strong year with significant growth in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit driven by healthy client demand, inventory utilization, and higher contribution from exclusive media. The company is actively expanding its footprint in the mobility and electric vehicle infrastructure ecosystem through strategic acquisitions and concessions, such as stakes in Kolkata Call Taxi and CharjKaro Greentech. Looking ahead to FY27, the company aims to continue expanding its exclusive media inventory, deepen its presence in the EV ecosystem, and maintain its growth trajectory and profitability. Cash Ur Drive Marketing Limited presented its investor presentation detailing its business model in transit media, outdoor advertising, digital OOH, and EV infrastructure media. The company highlighted its operational scale, including over 100,000 wrapped cabs, 1,900 buses, and 498 EV charging stations across more than 25 cities.

guidance.claim: The company targets to achieve equal contribution for exclusive and trade media in the next three years.
guidance.quote: So next three years the target is to achieve 50% equal contribution for exclusive as well as the trade media.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company can catalyze growth with the kind of trajectory it is on.
guidance.quote: I don't want to put any numbers to it, but I can assure that we can catalyze the growth with the kind of trajectory what we are on.

guidance.claim: Management confirmed that a year-on-year improvement in EBITDA margin is a fair assumption.
guidance.quote: For sure. That's a fair assumption.

guidance.claim: Management stated the target is to achieve 100 working capital days by implementing CRM and reconciliation tools.
guidance.quote: Going forward our target is to achieve 100 days by implementing this CRM, all the reconciliation tools and all these tools.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company expects similar growth with profitability this year.
guidance.quote: Similar growth with the profitability this year, that money to be added on, similar growth, we are a cash-rich company, debt-free company.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 30% to 35% growth trajectory supported by new media, geographies, and infrastructure expansion.
guidance.quote: Targeting 30–35% growth trajectory supported by new media, geographies, and infrastructure expansion

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that repeat business accounts for about 25% to 30% of total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: So if you are asking about the repeat business, repeat business would be about 25% to 30% of repeat business with our clients of the total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that rising urbanization, growing adoption of EVs, increasing demand for innovative advertising solutions, and an expanding portfolio provide significant headroom for growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising urbanization, growing adoption of EVs, increasing demand for innovative advertising solutions, and our expanding portfolio of media rights and infrastructure assets provide significant headroom for growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 19% stake in Kolkata Call Taxi.
capex_expansion.quote: We have acquired approximately 19% stake in Kolkata Call Taxi, strengthening our presence with the urban mobility ecosystem which can change the future of the infrastructure in India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired 50% stake in CharjKaro Greentech Mobility Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also acquired 50% stake in CharjKaro Greentech Mobility Limited, which will help us providing a rapidly growing EV charging stations under PM E-Drive and other government initiatives and get associated advertising opportunities on all these EV charging stations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured a 10-year build-operate model on concession from Nagar Nigam Rishikesh for EV charging infrastructure and advertising rights.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, we have secured 10 years build-operate model on concession from Nagar Nigam Rishikesh for EV charging infrastructure and advertising rights, creating a long-duration asset linked to the platform of further growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated there would be an additional investment of about INR3 crores to INR4 crores in the next 2 to 3 years to build up charging systems.
capex_expansion.quote: So there would be additional investment of about INR3 crores to INR4 crores which will go in next 2 years to 3 years to build up the charging systems because there are about 350 charging stations we will be advertising.

capex_expansion.claim: The company holds a 50% stake in CharjKaro Greentech Mobility.
The company reported setting up an in-house printing facility with an investment of approximately six crore rupees.
capex_expansion.quote: Setting up in-house printing facility (~₹6 Cr investment)

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, revenue from operations increased by 33.98% year-on-year to INR186.7 crores.
margins_costs.quote: For FY26, our revenue from operations has increased by 33.98% year-on-year basis to INR186.7 crores compared to INR139.3 crores in FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit for FY26 stood at INR29.4 crores, registering a growth of 64.98% compared to INR17.8 crores in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: Net profit of the year stood at INR29.4 crores, registering a growth of 64.98% compared to INR17.8 crores in FY25.

margins_costs.claim: During H2 FY26, revenue increased by 43.72% year-on-year to INR108.8 crores.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, revenue has gone up by 43.72% year-on-year basis to INR108.8 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Exclusive media contribution to revenue increased from 19% last year to 32% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: So Disha, the last year the exclusive media contributed to 19% of the revenue. This year it has gone up to 32%. So around INR60 crores of revenue from operations has come to -- is contributed by exclusive media.

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted that exclusive media generates approximately two times the margins compared to traded media.
margins_costs.quote: Exclusive media generates ~2x margins vs traded media

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company has built strong footprints across 25 cities and served more than 1,000 campaigns.
orders_capacity.quote: We have built strong footprints across 25 cities and have served more than 1,000 campaigns for leading brands which have continued our relationship with all our marquee clients across the industry.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the average inventory utilization is about 50% to 55% currently.
orders_capacity.quote: So the average utilization would be about 50%, 55% right now.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated the company does not have an order book system and all received orders are implemented orders.
orders_capacity.quote: All, see we don't have an order book system. So whatever order we receive, it is a implemented order only.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates over 100,000 wrapped cabs.
The company has over 1,900 buses in its network.
The company has 498+ EV charging stations.
The company operates 354+ Public Bicycle Shelters.
The company manages 95+ Digital OOH Screens.
The company has a presence across 25+ cities.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised 60.79 crore rupees from its listing on NSE Emerge.
capital_allocation.quote: – Listed on NSE Emerge; ₹60.79 crore raised

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the Everest Fleet case is currently in arbitration.
risks_headwinds.quote: So that is in the arbitration right now. So it's still in the arbitration.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the target is to achieve 50% equal contribution for exclusive as well as trade media in the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: So next three years the target is to achieve 50% equal contribution for exclusive as well as the trade media.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that additional investment of about INR3 crores to INR4 crores will go in the next 2 to 3 years to build up charging systems.
management_commitments.quote: So there would be additional investment of about INR3 crores to INR4 crores which will go in next 2 years to 3 years to build up the charging systems because there are about 350 charging stations we will be advertising.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the target is to achieve 100 working capital days by implementing CRM, reconciliation tools, and other tools.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward our target is to achieve 100 days by implementing this CRM, all the reconciliation tools and all these tools.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that receivables will be sorted by the first half of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So that will be, sorted by the first half of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an exclusive media revenue mix of approximately 50% over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting ~50% revenue mix over next 3–5 years

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
